slides.caption:
POV: he couldn't say it.
so he made her this.
slides.note: From inside a train: the window, the platform starting to slide past, morning light. Same couple, same week, your own photo.
Halfway, the postcard: London on his island, Edinburgh on hers, the kilometres in big numbers, the paper plane waiting at his door.
Halfway, mid-flight after she blows: the bubble at the middle reads "got a 16-25 railcard. its 4 hours 20. dont be weird about it"

messages.text: a man just gave me a tissue
